t2.subject: Step 1: Encapsulate var_map behind VarMap wrapper API
t2.description: Add a VarMap wrapper struct in unlace-ir/src/ssa.rs that encapsulates the storage. Initially backed by the same BTreeMap internally but with a clean API: get(bid, idx, slot), set(bid, idx, slot, sv), remove(bid, idx, slot), iter(), range(bid, idx). All 208 direct var_map.insert/remove/get call sites must go through these methods. The field becomes private (pub(crate) at most). This is the prerequisite for swapping the backing store without touching callers.
t2.acceptance_criteria: cargo check -p unlace-ir passes; VarMap struct compiles with get/set/remove/iter methods; existing var_map field type changed to VarMap

t1.subject: Replace var_map BTreeMap with flat IndexVec (rustc-style O(1) lookup)
t1.description: Replace SsaFunction::var_map: BTreeMap<(BlockId, usize, VarnodeSlot), SsaVarnode> with a flat IndexVec-style structure. Each block gets a Vec of per-instruction slot arrays. Forward lookup becomes O(1) indexing instead of O(log n) tree search. This is ~2000 lines across the SSA builder + every pass that accesses var_map. Slice into sub-tasks.
t1.acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p unlace-passes --lib passes 1035/1035; cargo test -p unlace-ir --lib passes; wc decompile output byte-identical; perf shows BTreeMap::search_tree < 5% (was 16%)
